resources.string: Automatic · right-wrist illustration while the Band reports its wrist
Slide your thumb up or down along the side of your index finger.
Move the selection or scroll the current text.
Touch the tips of your thumb and index finger together once, then release.
Open the selected item. If the display is asleep, the first pinch wakes it.
Touch the tips of your thumb and middle finger together once, then release.
Return to the previous view or close the current menu.
Slide your thumb sideways across your index finger to the left or right.
Move to the previous or next choice. In the launcher, scroll to a row, pinch to enter it, then scroll to an app.
Tap your thumb against your middle finger twice in quick succession.
Focus the app sidebar. Scroll to choose an app.
Tap your thumb against your middle finger three times in quick succession.
Hold your thumb and middle finger together, then release when the menu appears.
Show the controls for the current Faceclaw session.
In a chat, hold your thumb and index finger together, keep your wrist still, and speak. Lift your thumb to finish.
Record a message while the pinch is held.
Tap thumb and index three times to toggle the pointer. Aim with your wrist, then pinch your index to click or your middle finger to go back.
Point at and select controls that support on-screen clicking.
Tap thumb and index twice in quick succession.
Use the same action as double-tapping the glasses or ring. Go back in apps or turn the display off from the app sidebar. Repeat to wake it.
Pinch thumb and index, then start turning your wrist while keeping the pinch.
Scroll one step at a time as you turn.
